reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: lines 275-276 add entire cells/proofs arrays (`cellsAndProofs[i].cells` and `cellsAndProofs[i].proofs`) instead of selecting the column-specific element (`cellsAndProofs[i].cells[column_index]`). Spec requirement from 01e_PARTIAL_W3B4_1771748827.json property PROP-57888860-inv-029 explicitly requires: 'Each sidecar must contain exactly one cell and one proof per blob in the block' with assertion `len(sidecar.column) == len(kzg_commitments)`. The code violates this by producing sidecars with `len(sidecar.column) == len(kzg_commitments) * NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS` cells. Severity calibrated to Medium per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json: Nimbus market share (~6%) falls in Medium range (>5%), and this bug affects all Nimbus nodes that process PeerDAS blocks, causing gossip validation failures network-wide.
